description: Premium-over-spot statistics across fresh verified public offers, optionally filtered by metal and product format — INCLUDING the single lowest-premium dealer and product (lowestPremiumOffer: dealer, product, premium %, price, delivered total, checked-at), so 'which dealer has the lowest premium' is answerable from this one call. The median fields are pool statistics, not a dealer's price.
